Lemma
[Near-maximal simplex angles] \group mostow ↗ thurston-ch06-simplex-volume-bound Source: thurston:page-0144, thurston:page-0145

Any simplex whose volume is sufficiently close to $v_3$ has all dihedral angles close to $60^\circ $. Moreover, for a face angle $\beta $ of such a simplex, \[ v_3-v(\sigma )\geq C\beta ^2 \] for a uniform constant $C>0$.
